title: Partner Mirror Warm-Up
description: Partners face each other and mirror simple footwork patterns without a ball, waking up the legs and building early-practice focus.

content.objective: Get the feet and eyes working together before practice starts.
content.setup: Partners stand two metres apart facing each other anywhere on the court.
instructions: The leader shuffles, chops their feet, or jumps side to side; the partner mirrors it live.
Add a direction change (leader moves forward/back) once the group is warm.
Finish with ten seconds of fast feet in place.
coachingPoints: Stay on the balls of the feet.
React, don't anticipate — watch the leader's hips.
Keep a slight knee bend throughout.
commonMistakes: Standing too far apart to react in time.
Watching the leader's feet instead of their whole body.
Skipping the easier reps and going straight to full intensity.
content.safety: Leave enough space between pairs so nobody collides.
